ic.overview.title: Welcome!
ic.overview.summary:
Welcome to the UbiLife study.

Before we begin, we want to tell you about the study and your participation.
We want to understand different aspects of your participation in the UbiComp 2025 conference.
ic.overview.content:
We invite you to participate in the UbiLife Data Collection Study, focusing on understanding your participation in the UbiComp 2025 conference while also making a demonstration of the CARP Mobile Sensing Framework. Participation involves using this mobile app during the conference (one week) and to fill in small surveys and take pictures.

Principal Investigator:
Prof. Jakob E. Bardram, MSc., PhD,
Department of Health Technology,
Technical University of Denmark, Ørsteds Plads,
DK-2800 Kgs. Lyngby 
email: jakba@dtu.dk

Feel free to reach out with any questions about the study.
ic.data.title: Data Gathering
ic.data.summary: To get a good picture of your participation in the UbiComp 2025 conference, we will collect both active survey data and passive sensing data.
ic.data.content: This study collects demographic data like age, gender, and academic background; active survey data on sleep, stress, and conference attendance; and passive sensing data about your daily behaviors (step count, activity), contextual factors (location, weather, noise, Light), and device usage (battery level, network type) and technical device information).
ic.data_use.title: Data Use
ic.data_use.summary: Data will be used for scientific purposes only. Data will be shared with the UbiComp community and published in a Pervasive Computing journal in an anonymized format.
ic.data_use.content: Data will be used for scientific purposes only. Data will be shared with the UbiComp community and published in a Pervasive Computing journal in an anonymized format.
ic.privacy.title: Privacy
ic.privacy.summary: Your participation is completely anonymized. The Technical University of Denmark (DTU) is the data responsible of this study and all data will be collected and stored on secure servers, protecting your privacy
ic.privacy.content:
Participation in this study is completely anonymized and no person-identifiable information will be collected.

The Technical University of Denmark (DTU) is the data responsible of this study.

Data is collected and stored on secure servers operated by DTU.
ic.tasks.title: Study Tasks and Time Commitment
ic.tasks.summary: To get at good picture of your engagement in the conference, we will ask you to use the app on a daily basis for one week.
ic.tasks.content:
This study involves three main activities.

First, you should install the app and sign up using a QR code. You should also allow the app to access the data on your phone, like location and the camera.

Second, you should use the app daily during the conference and fill in surveys and take pictures. It is important that you keep the app running in the background and DO NOT swipe it out of memory. At the end of the conference there is a small 'Goodbye survey' to complete.

Finally, you can close and remove the app from your phone. This will delete all local data.
ic.location.title: Location
ic.location.summary: This study collects location and uses the location service on the phone.
ic.location.content:
This study collects location data.

We ask you to enable the location service on the phone by allowing tracking of location 'Always'. The location service will keep the app running in the background, which helps us collect the data.

We use the location data in our subsequent data analysis. in order to calculate how much time you spend at the conference, for example.
ic.participation.title: Voluntary Participation
ic.participation.summary: Your participation in this study is voluntary and you can withdraw at any time and without giving a reason.
ic.participation.content:
Your participation in this study is voluntary.

It is up to you to decide whether or not to take part in this study. Withdrawing from this study will not affect the relationship you have, if any, with the researchers.

If you withdraw from the study, your data can be deleted upon request by providing us the unique study deployment ID you have.
ic.consent.confirmation: I have read and I understand the provided information and have had the opportunity to ask questions. I understand that my participation is voluntary and that I am free to withdraw at any time, without giving a reason and without cost. I understand that I will be given a copy of this consent form. I voluntarily agree to take part in this study.
ic.thanks.title: Thank You!
ic.thanks.content: We saved your consent document. Please proceed to give us some details about you.
ic.review.title: Informed Consent
ic.review.reason: Have you read, understood and agreed to use this app for the study as explained?
ic.completion.title: Thank you!
ic.completion.text: You are now ready to participate in the UbiLife study. Have a great time at UbiComp 2025!
study.description.title: UbiLife Data Collection Study
study.description.purpose: To collect real-time active and passive mobile sensing data from UbiComp 2025 participants
study.description.description: We collect active and passive data from smartphones in order to demonstrate the CARP Mobile Sensing Framework and to provide overall insight into conference participation.
study.responsible.name: Jakob E. Bardram
study.responsible.title: Professor
onboarding.title: Onboarding Survey
onboarding.description: Please enter your details for study onboarding.
onboarding.instruction.title: Welcome to the UbiLife Study Onboarding Survey.
onboarding.instruction.text: In the following we will ask you a few demographic questions about you and your academic background. Please answer each question to the best of your knowledge.
onboarding.age.question: What is your current age?
onboarding.gender.question: What is your gender?
onboarding.academic.question: What is your academic status?
onboarding.presenter.question: Are you presenting at this conference?
onboarding.prior.question: How many UbiComp conferences have you participated in?
onboarding.research.question: What is your research area?
onboarding.alcohol.question2: How many times do you drink during the week?
onboarding.alcohol.question3: How many glasses do you normally drink?
offboarding.title: Offboarding Survey
offboarding.description: When you're done with the study, please fill in this survey.
offboarding.instruction.title: We hope you have enjoyed your time at UbiComp 2025.
offboarding.instruction.text: In the following we will ask you a few questions about your experience during the conference and your participation in this UbiLife study.
offboarding.friends.question: Did you meet old friends or make new ones at this conference?
offboarding.friends.option1: I meet up with old friends
offboarding.friends.option4: I didn't meet anyone I knew
offboarding.social.question: What were your favorite social activities at the conference?
offboarding.social.option3: UbiStar: Barhopping and Karaoke in Helsinki
offboarding.social.option4: UbiRelax: Walk along the water in Otaniemi
offboarding.social.option8: UbiStudio: Tour through the Marsio building
offboarding.social.option10: U-bi-U: Just give me my food
offboarding.social.option12: I didn't attend any social activities
offboarding.retro.title: Conference Retrospective
offboarding.retro.text:
Conference Retrospective.

We would like to hear your thoughts on how we can improve future UbiComp conferences.
offboarding.retro.keep: What should be kept for future UbiComp conferences?
offboarding.retro.stop: What should be stopped in future UbiComp conferences?
offboarding.retro.start: What should be started in future UbiComp conferences?
offboarding.finland.question: Which Finnish things did you do while here?
offboarding.finland.option4: I went swimming in a lake
offboarding.finland.option6: I met Santa Claus in Rovaniemi
offboarding.finland.option7: I got a Finnish design artifact
offboarding.finland.option8: I tasted Finnish vodka or minttu
offboarding.completion.title: GOODBYE
offboarding.completion.thanks:
Thank you for participating in the UbiLife study. We hope to see you again at future UbiComp conferences!

Please wait 10 minutes before uninstalling the app, so that we can upload the last data from your phone. After this, it is safe to uninstall the app. All data on your phone will be deleted when you uninstall the app.

survey.who5.title: WHO Well-Being Index
survey.who5.description: A short 5-item survey on your well-being.
survey.who5.more_half: More than half of the time
survey.who5.less_half: Less than half of the time
survey.who5.instructions.title: WHO Well-Being Index
survey.who5.instructions.description:
Please indicate for each of the following five statements which is closest to how you have been feeling over the last two weeks. Notice that higher numbers mean better well-being.

Example: If you have felt cheerful and in good spirits more than half of the time during the last two weeks, select the box with the label 'More than half of the time'.
survey.who5.question.1: I have felt cheerful and in good spirits
survey.who5.question.2: I have felt calm and relaxed
survey.who5.question.3: I have felt active and vigorous
survey.who5.question.4: I woke up feeling fresh and rested
survey.who5.question.5: My daily life has been filled with things that interest me
survey.who5.completion.title: Finished
survey.who5.completion.description: Thank you for filling out the survey!
